questions: 1. Tell me about your academic journey starting from 10th standard to your Graduation/Post-Graduation, including your marks, achievements, and any drop in academic performance.
2. Why did you choose your particular stream of education (Science/Arts/Commerce/Engineering)? If you could go back in time, would you choose differently?
3. Describe your relationship with your parents and siblings. Whom are you closest to, and why? Give an instance where you had a major disagreement with your parents and how it was resolved.
4. Who is your best friend? What are the qualities you admire in them? What is one quality they have that you dislike or think they should improve?
5. What are your major achievements in sports and extracurricular activities? How have they shaped your personality?
6. Tell me about your hobbies and interests. How much time do you dedicate to them in a week?
7. What is your daily routine on a typical working day versus a Sunday or a holiday?
8. Why do you want to join the Armed Forces instead of pursuing a lucrative corporate career? What inspired this choice?
9. If you had 1 lakh rupees right now, how exactly would you spend or invest it?
10. Tell me about a time you faced a significant failure or setback in your life. How did you bounce back?
11. What are your top 3 strengths and 3 weaknesses? Give examples. What concrete steps are you taking to overcome your weaknesses?
12. (For Repeaters) Why do you think you were not recommended in your previous attempts? What have you done differently this time?
13. If you are not recommended in this SSB, what is your alternate career plan (Plan B)?
14. Tell me about your pocket money or earnings. How do you manage your finances?
15. Who is your role model, and how have they influenced your life decisions?
16. How do you manage stress or pressure situations? Give an example of a high-pressure situation you handled successfully.
17. Tell me about a time when you had to lead a team or take charge of a situation unexpectedly.
18. What are your views on the current political scenario of India? (Testing awareness, not bias)
19. Which branch of the Armed Forces do you want to join (Army/Navy/AF), and which specific Arm/Service do you prefer? Why?
20. Have you ever broken a rule or a law? Be honest and tell me the circumstances.
